title: Accounts
subtitle: Every bank account, wallet, cash, debt and asset has its own balance.
emptyBody: Add the bank accounts, e-wallets and cash you use. Each one keeps its own balance.

role.label: Use
role.help: Only spending accounts count toward the daily allowance.

fields.name: Name
fields.last4Help: Tells apart several accounts at the same bank.
fields.aliasesHelp: Comma separated, for example: gopay, gp
fields.openingDebt: Amount owed on the start date
fields.isDefaultHelp: Used when you only type the bank name.

checkBody: Enter the balance your bank or app shows right now.
smallFee: {amount} less than recorded. Probably an admin fee.
large: A difference of {amount} is large. Some transactions are probably not recorded yet.
recurringFee: This fee of {amount} repeats every month. Add it as a recurring bill?
account_has_transactions: This account has transactions. Archive it instead.
currency_locked: The currency cannot change once the account has transactions.
unknown_currency: Add this currency in Settings first.
large_difference: The difference is too large for a category. Adjust instead.
